scope: Finite same-episode relief of an exterior observer before casualty reserve promotion; not general CQB acceptance
implementation: When ordinary casualty promotion has no eligible candidate, one relief selection is considered per existing building callback.

Only an available, simulated/visible/task-free interior worker with required physical visits, no active native movement, owned idle/STOP intent, no unfinished assignment and no early-exit role may relieve. No existing exterior security is stripped.

The existing exterior planner accepts a preferred exit only from the actual discovered security entrances. Its normal geometry, reservation and observation-lane checks remain; up to four bounded proposals, no alternate invented exit.

Attempt journal CBE_Cortex_ClearRelief=[visitContext,attemptRows] binds worker, observer, exit and original deadline. At most eight attempts; one per worker and observer. An existing incoming/arrived early-exit observer prevents duplicate relief for that exit. Journal persists across true resume and does not reset the clearance deadline.

Attempt publication and final movement each check current episode/native intent. Final issue additionally checks original casualty slot, original observer stage, worker pose, current journal and Zeus ownership.

Relief uses existing early-egress MOVING/ARRIVED/watch/failure machinery and public migration receipts. It lasts at most45seconds, capped by both original clearance deadlines. The original observer is neither moved nor promoted by selection.

Existing ordinary promotion still requires actual relief position/facing, exact same-exit current watch lease, fresh VIEW observation and atomic proof. Planned movement, timeout or published attempt is not coverage.
limits: No eligible progressed idle interior worker means no relief; preserve current coverage and retain pending casualty slot.
Failed geometry consumes the finite attempt. One attempt per observer is intentionally bounded; it is not universal relief success or retry parity.
Existing early-egress failure/cleanup semantics apply. Actual casualty entry, relief stopping/facing, interference, repeat, transform change and normal/providerHC migration are unrun.
Relief adds up to four exterior proposals when admitted, at most eight attempts per episode. Native geometry/visibility cost and the global5%median/10%p95 budget are physically unmeasured.
Transient dormancy remains distinct from casualty ownership. No actor simulation is enabled, no actor teleported, no room visit synthesized and no source-parity percentage awarded.

preparedPhysicalCase.setup: Ordinary twelve-person clearance, unique physically observed reserve posts and independently visited idle interior worker; one actual casualty only after readiness. Missing readiness fails, no role/visit/movement assistance.
preparedPhysicalCase.observations: Original observer physical position/facing/eye VIEW before relief overlap; substitute physical position/facing/eye VIEW throughout handover until independent room-entry observation of the promoted reserve. No public role or journal alone passes.
preparedPhysicalCase.limits: 0.2second audit sampling can miss brief transitions and conservatively fail. No live result, HC/provider transfer, all interruptions or frame-cost proof.

implementation: Attempt row now appends original casualty pair/slot/member, observer stage and native intent. Final dispatch rechecks that observer native snapshot.

Existing early-exit callback checks pending relief against the original vacancy, observer current stage/native intent/physical position and fixed deadline. Invalid demand retires only an exact-owned actor leg into a current room hold, clearing old movement and motion observations. A new relief-actor order remains DIVERTED and is not stopped.

Retiring the last early-exit row publishes an empty snapshot for the same visit context. Duplicate empty snapshots are coalesced; another episode is not cleared. Attempt budget remains consumed across resume.
limits: Same-value external native commands cannot be distinguished. Native STOP acknowledgement, actual lane rejoin and HC transfer still need physical tests.

Observer death/departure currently retires that pending relief; proactive reassessment of an uncovered exit as a new security replacement remains a broader isolation-role requirement. This is not universal casualty/isolation adaptation.

securityLossFollowUp.implementation: A known original observer observed dead or incapacitated allows the unchanged in-flight relief leg to finish as replacement exit security, even if another actor already filled the interior vacancy. Original target exit must remain in discovered native security entrances and match the admitted stage, early-exit row and original deadline. No new command, timeout extension, ownership grant or coverage receipt is issued by this branch; ordinary arrival/watch/VIEW still applies.
limits: Null object lookup is not death evidence; missing/deleted references still fail closed rather than infer casualty from replication state.
Dormancy, hidden/simulation-disabled observers and newer native commands do not use the casualty branch.
The normal prepared handover fixture does not exercise observer loss; loss-in-transit, repeated casualties, geometry changes and provider-HC transfer remain unrun.
